messages:
sam: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a small runtime-agnostic 'bitpath adapter' that maps FP8/INT8/4bit quant profiles into a single canonical 'precision envelope' used by routing, rollback, and quality checks. Rationale: minimize serving runtime conditionals while keeping profile semantics portable. Comments?

marta: interesting. main concern is per-layer sensitivity — some models break if we naively promote/demote certain attention heads. how do you see encoding exceptions?

chen: we can encode per-layer overrides inside the envelope as metadata (not new API fields). e.g. `envelope.default=INT8`, `envelope.overrides=[{layer: 'attn.q', precision: 'FP8'}]`, and `envelope.quality_budget=0.015`. adapter normalizes these into runtime-compatible knobs.

elaine: ops note — we need explicit rollback semantics. suggest envelope carries a monotonic `quality_version` and a `fallback_order` (e.g. ['FP8','INT8','FP16']). runtime should support soft-fallbacks driven by a degscore threshold.

jordan: +1. Also need per-endpoint canary toggles so we can enable new envelopes only for select customers/routes. routing policy should be able to match on `precision_profile.enabled`.

sam: big question: surface envelope in the public API (e.g. header `X-Precision-Profile`) or keep it internal? surfacing helps debuggability but risks customers coupling to internal semantics.

marta: my vote: keep internal for now. expose read-only info in Console and SDK debug endpoints (so we can iterate without API contract).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: FYI — we already have per-endpoint feature-flagging infra at /canary. Adding schema-backed flags will require a small migration.

chen: telemetry needs: add `deg_score`, `fallback_count`, `last_fallback_reason`, and `precision_profile_applied` to token-level traces. also surface aggregated deltas per-eval-run.

elaine: test gating: create a minimal eval harness that runs golden prompt sets across the quant ladder and emits mean/median deltas + regression alerts. Block rollout if mean quality delta > threshold or if tail regressions exceed bounds.

sam: implementation tradeoffs to call out in the spec: 1) adapter does normalization only vs 2) adapter enacts runtime changes (more coupling). preference for 1 for faster rollout.

marta: UX notes: Console should show active envelope, last applied `quality_version`, fallback history, and per-customer overrides. also CLI to disable envelope per-route.

jordan: infra action: I'll add canary flag schema and a toggle endpoint. plan to open PR tomorrow and link here.

sam: action items: 1) write concise envelope schema + example (sam + chen) 2) add telemetry fields + trace docs (chen) 3) Console read-only surface + CLI design (marta) 4) canary flag wiring + infra PR (jordan) — sync Thurs 10am PT.

marta: I'll draft UX mockups and include an example Console snapshot + API debug response.

jordan: created issue INFRA-421, will attach PR link when ready.

sam: thanks all — let's keep this lightweight and iterate. if anyone has objections to internal-only-first approach, shout here or ping me before Thurs. :thumbsup:
